p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Explain why this alone is not complete network security.
code_first.a: Lock account; then no output; layered controls are still needed.

original_exam_questions: State one role of DNS. [2 marks]
Resolves domain names to IP addresses.
Name the device that connects networks. [1 mark]
Explain why encryption alone does not prevent phishing. [3 marks]
Encryption protects data in transit but cannot stop a user willingly entering credentials into a fraudulent site.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: Three failed attempts trigger the warning at >=3.

stretch.task: Add an earlier warning for exactly two failures.

mastery.task: Design a small layered-security decision system with authentication status, MFA and account-lock state; test conflicting conditions.
mastery.hint: Account locked should override other successful factors.
mastery.answer: Locked+valid factors Deny; unlocked+password/MFA true Allow; either factor missing Deny. Explain why firewalls/encryption cover different risks.
